episodes.title: Game Knight
episodes.summary: Bruce's plans of having the perfect family-game-night unravel when Damian and Claire become suspicious of their newest family member.

episodes.title: Bat Trip
episodes.summary: Damian and the Dent twins accidentally unleash parademons when they try to shake their chaperone, Bruce Wayne, on a class field trip to Star-Labs.

episodes.title: 90 is the New 80
episodes.summary: Trouble finds Little Batman when he ignores his dad's advice and coerses Alfred to become Exo-Bat to help him take down the Mad Hatter.

episodes.title: All In A Bat Day's Work
episodes.summary: The Bat-Fam stumbles upon a sinister caper that involves Wayne Enterprises on "Go to Work With a Grown-Up Day".

episodes.title: A Knight at the Movies
episodes.summary: Bruce decides it's time to let Alicia in on his "little secret"- that he's Batman. However, Alicia has a little secret of her own.

episodes.title: The Art Of Claire
episodes.summary: When an old pal/fellow ex-criminal makes Claire an irresistible offer, she finds herself having to choose between her new life and her old one.

episodes.title: ManBatMan
episodes.summary: After Bruce tells Damian that a crime spree of stolen Goki Cards isn't a big enough caper for the Batmen, Damian teams up with Dr. Langstrom.

episodes.title: An Interview With a Batman
episodes.summary: Bruce becomes his own worst enemy when he tries to keep E*Vil out of his tightly planned family interview with Vicky Vale.

episodes.title: April Fools! Part 1
episodes.summary: As a dark plot unfolds, it will take every member of the Bat-Fam working together to save Gotham and it's citizens.

episodes.summary: As a dark plot unfolds, it will take every member of the Bat-Fam working together to save Gotham and it's citizens.
